ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (14) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form); blocks 5, 11, 12, 13 had no website counterpart and were translated fresh.

«Непротивление злу насилием» (neprotivlenie zlu nasiliem) is 'non-resistance to evil by violence' and «противление злу злом» (protivlenie zlu zlom) 'resistance to evil with evil', kept distinct as in the Russian; «неправда» (nepravda) is 'wrong'. The paragraph on whether the teaching can be fulfilled («исполнимо», ispolnimo, 'can be fulfilled'), which the website draft lacked, and the footnote on Adin Ballou were translated fresh; the attribution is surname only, «Балу» ('Ballou'), as printed.
